sources.title: Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-Gaussian-Splash: Image-to-Image model — overview ...
sources.snippet: Overview Qwen-Image-Edit-2511-Gaussian-Splash is a specialized image-to-image model trained code-free on ModelScope that performs 3D Gaussian splatting-based image editing with a focus on perspective correction and inpainting of blank regions. Maintained by dx8152, this model uses the diffusers library and is licensed under Apache 2.0. The critical distinction of this variant is its emphasis ...
